message: You know how every time you hear the smoke alarm, you have that brief moment of panic before you realize it’s just the toaster? 😅 Well, I’ve learned that being prepared for actual fire emergencies is a little more serious! I found this great resource from the Red Cross that lays out some practical tips on how to get ready. It’s a good reminder that a little planning can go a long way, even if it feels a bit silly at times. What’s your best tip for staying calm in a pinch?
